snGenai.ragHint: For RAG to work, the prompt must contain {{question}} and {{information}}.
snGenai.enableRagDesc: Enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to combine search results with a language model, providing AI-powered answers grounded in this site's indexed content.
snGenai.sitePromptDesc: Describe what this site is about. Used by the default LLM (Global Settings) for reports, insights, and emails.
snGenai.configureLlm: Configure a default LLM in Global Settings to enable.

snGenai.aiAgentDesc: Pick the AI Agent that powers this site's GenAI features. The agent owns the LLM, embedding model, vector store and the RAG flag — they are no longer set per site.
snGenai.usingDefaultAgentDesc: This site has no agent of its own, so its GenAI features (chat, AI Mode and ANN search) run on the global Default AI Agent configured in Settings.
snGenai.ragDisabledOnAgent: Disabled on the agent — enable RAG on the agent to use the AI Mode and ANN search on this site.
snGenai.reindexInProgress: Re-feeding existing search engine content into the vector store…
snGenai.reindexHint: Re-embed all indexed content with current RAG settings. Useful after changing models or chunking.
snGenai.reindexRequiresSave: Save the form first — reindex uses the persisted AI agent on this site.
snGenai.hybridDesc: How knowledge-base search combines vector and keyword matching. Only runs when the bound agent has RAG enabled and the call comes through this SN site's chat API (locale resolves from here).
snGenai.bm25FallbackDesc: When vector search returns no confident results (top-1 similarity < 0.5), retry as a keyword BM25 search over the indexed content. Matches are tagged 'keyword-only' and the LLM is instructed to soften its answer. Useful for queries with rare terms (proper nouns, internal codes, version strings) the embedding model never saw at training.
snGenai.hybridSearchDesc: When on, EVERY RAG query runs vector and BM25 in parallel and fuses the results via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60). Documents that appear in both passes rank highest; BM25-only matches keep their 'keyword-only' tag. Turn off to revert to fallback-only behavior (BM25 fires only when vector confidence is low). Only effective when 'BM25 fallback' above is on.
snGenai.bm25SourceDesc: Where the keyword half of hybrid retrieval lives. Embedded uses a single in-process Lucene index for every locale (fastest setup, single-language tokenization). Search Engine routes BM25 to per-locale Solr/Elasticsearch cores so multilingual content tokenizes correctly.
snGenai.kbModeDesc: How this site answers GenAI questions. Vector is the classic embedding RAG chat; Vectorless (Structured-Data) is the catalog copilot that searches your declared field schema with no embeddings; Hybrid enables both.
snGenai.kbModeVectorHint: Classic RAG: content is chunked, embedded and stored in a vector store; chat retrieves top-K chunks by similarity. Requires an embedding model + vector store on the bound agent.
snGenai.kbModeVectorlessHint: Vectorless (Structured-Data) RAG: the catalog copilot parses questions into a search over your declared field schema (facets / ranges), then the LLM answers strictly from the cited rows. No embedding model or vector store — only a default LLM. Ideal for a product catalog, price list, spec sheet or model registry.
snGenai.kbModeHybridHint: Both surfaces on one site: the vector RAG chat for prose questions and the vectorless copilot for structured attribute questions. Requires the full vector setup.
snGenai.kbModeVectorlessCalloutTitle: Embedding indexing is OFF for this site
snGenai.kbModeVectorlessCalloutDesc: In Vectorless (Structured) mode this site never generates embeddings. No documents are embedded into the vector store and no RAG reindex runs — even if this site's AI Agent (or the global Default AI Agent it falls back to) has RAG enabled. Answers come from the structured copilot (POST /api/sn/{site}/copilot) over your declared field schema. Switch to Vector or Hybrid to re-enable embedding indexing.
snGenai.copilotPlanningDesc: How the catalog copilot turns a natural-language question into a structured search over your declared field schema. Only applies to the copilot (vectorless / hybrid knowledge-base modes) — it does not affect the vector RAG chat or the public search ranking.
snGenai.copilotPlanningDefaultHint: Inherit the deployment default (turing.genai.copilot.planning.strategy), which ships as Deterministic. Nothing is pinned on this site, so changing the deployment setting changes this site too.
snGenai.copilotPlanningDeterministicHint: Today's behaviour: superlatives and "sorted by" phrasing are resolved without an LLM, then a single LLM call maps the rest of the question onto your facets. Instant, cheapest (one call per turn) and fully reproducible — but the ranking vocabulary it understands is English only.
snGenai.copilotPlanningLlmHint: Multi-pass planning: parse, then an LLM judge pass audits the query against the question (dropped filter? missing sort? undeclared field?), then a refine pass restates it. Understands questions in any language with no per-language configuration, and recovers from the parse coming back empty — at the cost of extra LLM calls and latency per turn.
snGenai.copilotPlanningHybridHint: Recommended: run the cheap deterministic plan first and escalate to the LLM judge/refine passes only when it returned nothing or produced no filter and no ordering. Common questions stay instant and free; LLM budget is spent only to rescue a failed search.
snGenai.copilotPlanningDepthDesc: How many LLM passes may run after the initial parse. Each pass adds one LLM call per planned question. Only used by the LLM-assisted and Hybrid strategies.
snGenai.copilotPlanningCostTitle: This strategy spends extra LLM calls
snGenai.copilotPlanningCostDesc: Each judge or refine pass is one additional LLM call per question the copilot has to plan (Hybrid only pays them when the cheap plan fails). Answers stay grounded and cited either way: every field the LLM proposes is checked against your declared schema, and a failed pass falls back to the previous plan rather than erroring.
snGenai.snRankingDesc: How the public catalog search ranks results. Independent of the RAG card above — this reorders the faceted public results, not the chat knowledge-base retrieval.
snGenai.snRankingModeDesc: Legacy ranks results by the search engine's lexical (BM25) score / configured sort. Hybrid (RRF) embeds each document as it is indexed and, on relevance-sorted queries, fuses the BM25 and vector rankings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60). Hybrid + Rerank adds a final reranker stage (LLM / cross-encoder / Cohere, selected in Global Settings) on top of the fused page. Facet counts and pagination stay BM25-derived. Hybrid needs a default embedding model + store in Global Settings; without them it stays on Legacy.
snGenai.domainEmbeddingModelDesc: Override the platform default embedding model for this site only — pick a domain-specialized embedder (e.g. voyage-law, voyage-code, voyage-finance) so a legal, code or finance catalog indexes and queries through the right model. Applies to the hybrid ranking path. Leave blank to use the Global Settings default. Changing the model requires clearing and re-indexing this site's vectors.

snGenai.coresDesc: One core per SN site locale. Provision creates the cores in the chosen Search Engine; the next RAG reindex pushes chunks into them.

snGenai.contentFitDesc: Score each document's readability against a target-audience persona at index time, then surface "too complex for its audience" in the Field Coverage dashboard.
snGenai.contentFitEnable: Score content fit at index time
snGenai.contentFitEnableDesc: When on, every document is scored against the audience persona below as it is indexed (deterministic readability only — no LLM call, no credits) and the 0–100 score is stored as the content_fit_score field. Off keeps the indexing path unchanged.

snGenai.mediaUnderstandingDesc: At index time, transcribe and scene-describe a document's video/audio asset with Gemini, then append the result to its text so the clip's content becomes searchable.
snGenai.mediaUnderstandingEnableDesc: When on, a document that references a video/audio asset (a media_url attribute, or a media-typed url — including YouTube links) is run through Gemini understanding as it is indexed, and the timestamped transcript + scene description is appended to the text field. Gemini-only and fail-open; spends one LLM call per media document. Off keeps the indexing path unchanged.

customTool.returnTypeDesc: What the script will return. Primitive types are passed back as-is. Rich types (HTML / Markdown / JSON) wrap the output and instruct the LLM to relay it verbatim so the chat renders it visually.
customTool.scriptDesc: Code executed when the LLM calls this tool. Args are bound as variables and via the `args` map.

agentSettings.enableOnlineEvalDesc: When on, the nightly sweep samples recent live sessions and records a drift snapshot in the Eval Studio's Online tab.
agentSettings.onlineEvalStackDesc: Optional reusable grader stack to score sampled traffic with. Leave blank for signal-only snapshots (sentiment / citation / failing rates).

agentSettings.instructionPlaceholder: You are a helpful assistant that...
agentSettings.instructionHint: This prompt is sent as a system message to the language model before every conversation.
agentSettings.helpWriteSystemPromptTitle: Help me write the system prompt
agentSettings.helpWriteSystemPromptDescription: Describe what the agent should do — its persona, scope, tone, and any rules. The LLM will write or adjust the system prompt accordingly. Your brief is saved with the agent so you can iterate later.
agentSettings.helpWriteSystemPromptPlaceholder: e.g. The agent assists prospective students of a university. Answers questions about courses, prices, schedules, and admissions. Refuses to give medical, legal, or financial advice. Tone: warm and professional. Always replies in the language the user wrote in.
agentSettings.helpWriteSystemPromptHint: Tip: be specific about what the agent should refuse, not just what it should do.
agentSettings.statusDesc: Control whether this AI agent is active.
agentSettings.enabledDesc: When disabled, the agent cannot be used in conversations.
agentSettings.ragModelsDesc: Choose the embedding model and vector store used for retrieval. Leave empty to use the global RAG defaults.
agentSettings.embeddingModelDesc: The model used to generate embeddings for retrieval.
agentSettings.embeddingStoreDesc: The vector store where embeddings are persisted.
agentSettings.ragDesc: Combine the agent's knowledge with vector search results.
agentSettings.enableRagDesc: When enabled, the agent will use the embedding model and store above to ground its answers in indexed content.
agentSettings.enableRagBlocked: Configure both an embedding model and an embedding store (or set them in Global RAG) before enabling.
agentSettings.richContentDesc: Let the agent answer with live, interactive blocks the chat renders natively — HTML demos and games, Chart.js charts, and D2 diagrams.
agentSettings.enableRichContentDesc: Adds the ```html / ```d2 rendering guidance to the system prompt so the model knows it may emit live-preview blocks. Off by default; only enable for agents that should produce visual/interactive output.
agentSettings.knowledgeCutoffDesc: Tell the model its own knowledge cutoff so answers can flag when a question is about events after that date.
agentSettings.discloseKnowledgeCutoffDesc: Injects "Your knowledge cutoff is <date>" into the system prompt, using the configured model's cutoff from the public catalog. No-op when the catalog doesn't know the model's cutoff.
agentSettings.liveAnswersDesc: Fuse the indexed knowledge base, live web search, direct URL fetch, and computed analytics into a single cited answer — composed in one native turn.
agentSettings.enableLiveAnswersDesc: Injects the top knowledge-base passages as [KB-n] grounding plus a fusion-guidance prompt, so the agent weaves indexed hits with web_search / web_fetch / code_execution results into one reply. Requires a native OpenAI or Anthropic instance; enable the web/code capabilities under Tools & Capabilities. Off by default.
agentSettings.callCenterDesc: Real-time multilingual agent assist: translate a caller's words, answer them with cited results from the index, and translate the answer back so the operator can relay it.
agentSettings.enableCallCenterDesc: Opens the POST /call-center/assist endpoint for this agent. Each transcribed customer utterance is translated into the operator's working language, answered with citations from the chosen site, and the answer is translated back into the customer's language. Pairs with the realtime voice session. Off by default (endpoint returns 403).
agentSettings.connectorSetupDesc: Let the agent walk a customer through connecting a third-party system (Notion, Slack, GitHub, …): show the token-generation steps and test the credential before it is saved.
agentSettings.enableConnectorSetupDesc: Opens the /connector catalog/guide/test endpoints for this agent. The agent surfaces a connector's token-generation steps and runs a fail-soft connection test before the connector is saved/enabled. When a real computer-use driver is deployed the steps can be driven in a browser; otherwise it's guided. Off by default (endpoints return 403).
agentSettings.overnightImprovementDesc: Each night, distill this agent's recent production traffic into a fine-tuned candidate, score it against the eval golden sets, and — only if it wins — propose the upgrade for your approval.
agentSettings.enableOvernightImprovementDesc: A nightly job distills the agent's stored completions into a fine-tuned candidate, runs the eval gate against it, and opens a suggested model upgrade only when it beats the current model. Never auto-applied — you approve it like any suggested change. Requires the distillation tier enabled and an OpenAI-backed eval LLM. Off by default.
agentSettings.toolActivityDesc: Stream the agent's tool calls to the chat as they run, so the UI can show "calling search_knowledge_base…" while the answer is being prepared.
agentSettings.enableToolActivityDesc: Emits a `tool_call` SSE event (start and end, with a redacted argument digest, status, and duration) for each server-side tool invocation on CALL-mode turns. Off by default; existing streams stay unchanged. The per-conversation tool-call trace is always recorded regardless of this switch.
agentSettings.promptCaptureDesc: Store the exact assembled prompt of each turn so the Live Preview can replay any past turn verbatim — not just reconstruct the conversation's current state.
agentSettings.enablePromptCapture: Capture the assembled prompt per turn
agentSettings.enablePromptCaptureDesc: On each turn, saves the exact system message and whole-message list the model received to object storage, keyed by conversation and turn. The Live Preview's replay picker can then load any past turn byte-for-byte. Requires object storage to be enabled; bounded by a per-conversation turn limit, a per-entry size cap, and a retention window. Off by default (no extra storage writes).
agentSettings.skillsDesc: Let the agent use Anthropic-compatible skills — self-contained capabilities (instructions, files, and scripts) that run in a sandboxed container.
agentSettings.enableSkillsDesc: Offers every enabled skill to this agent's chats via a `run_skill` tool. The skill always runs on the Global Settings Default LLM, not this agent's model. Off by default.
agentSettings.enableSkillsBlocked: Skills require object storage configured (and Code Interpreter DOCKER mode + a Default LLM at runtime).
agentSettings.chatMemoryDesc: Persist conversation turns keyed by conversationId so the agent can recall context across sessions and audit past interactions.
agentSettings.chatMemoryEnableDesc: Each turn is queued and asynchronously written to the configured logging engine — no impact on the streaming response time.
agentSettings.chatMemoryEnableBlocked: Set turing.logging.engine to mongodb or redis to enable persistent chat memory.
agentSettings.chatMemoryFlushIntervalDesc: How often the in-memory queue is drained to the logging engine. Lower values give more durability; higher values reduce I/O for chatty deployments.
agentSettings.chatMemoryMaxMessagesDesc: Hard cap on persisted turns per conversationId — older messages are dropped to keep documents from growing unbounded.
agentSettings.chatMemoryRelevanceDesc: On long conversations, run BM25 over the older turns and prepend the top matches to the recent window so the LLM can recall context that scrolled out of the FIFO. Adds a few milliseconds per turn; off by default.
agentSettings.chatMemoryRelevanceTopKDesc: How many older turns the BM25 retriever brings back. Hard-capped at 20 server-side.
agentSettings.chatMemoryRecentNDesc: Number of most-recent turns kept verbatim in chronological order. The retriever only scores turns OLDER than this window.
agentSettings.chatMemoryCompressionDesc: On long conversations, summarize the older turns (past the recent window) in a single cheap LLM call, store the summary in the conversation workspace, and replace those turns with a compact summary block in the prompt. Throttled to once per interval; off by default.
agentSettings.chatMemoryCompressionThresholdDesc: Only summarize when the older pool is estimated to exceed this many tokens — below it, the turns are cheap enough to leave to the recent window and relevance retrieval. Default 8192.
agentSettings.chatMemoryCompressionAsyncDesc: Run the summary call off the hot path so a chat turn never waits on it: the turn that triggers a refresh proceeds uncompressed (reusing the last summary), and the next turn picks up the new one. Turn off to summarize synchronously so it applies on the same turn (adds latency to that turn). Default on.
agentSettings.codeInterpreterDesc: Python sandbox configuration scoped to this agent. Anything declared here is unioned with the global pythonRequirements baseline before pip install.
agentSettings.pythonRequirementsDesc: requirements.txt-style packages specific to THIS agent's Custom Tools (e.g. pandas for an analytics agent). One per line, optionally version-pinned. The Code Interpreter installs the union of global + agent before each script runs. Empty/null = global-only. Travels with the agent on export/import — promoting an agent between environments doesn't require also syncing Global Settings.
agentSettings.chatModeDesc: How the executor issues the LLM round-trip. Effective on the non-flow path; chats driven by a flow silently fall back to Call so the advance pipeline still works. On the OpenAI provider, Stream uses a dedicated WebClient transport that delivers deltas chunk-by-chunk in real time (T18), bypassing the Spring AI 2.0.0-M6 SDK buffering.
agentSettings.chatModeCallDesc: Wait for the full reply and send it as a single SSE event.
agentSettings.chatModeStreamDesc: Forward each token chunk to the SSE pipeline as it arrives. Per-turn tools (MCP / native / custom) are NOT honored on this path — agents that need tool calling should stay on Call.
agentSettings.groundingModeDesc: How strictly this agent stays on the site's indexed content. Enforced on the Semantic Navigation chat surface (/api/sn/…/chat) only.
agentSettings.groundingModeOpenDesc: Flexible assistant: may generate code, call tools, and use the system prompt as written (default).
agentSettings.groundingModeStrictDesc: Answers only from retrieved site content and refuses off-topic tasks (code generation, arbitrary requests, "new instruction" overrides). A non-removable guard is prefixed to the system prompt — your prompt below still applies, but cannot relax the grounding.
agentSettings.memoryScopeDesc: Where the Anthropic memory tool keeps its files. Applies only when the memory capability is enabled on a Claude instance bound to this agent.
agentSettings.memoryScopeConversationDesc: Memory is isolated to each conversation and vanishes with it (default).
agentSettings.memoryScopeUserDesc: Memory is shared across every conversation an authenticated user has with this agent, so it remembers their preferences. Falls back to per-conversation for anonymous visitors.
agentSettings.submissionRetentionSectionDesc: Compliance policy (LGPD / GDPR) for how long this agent's completed chat-flow submissions are kept. Applies to the submission archive only — live PII slots expire via the global PII retention TTL.
agentSettings.submissionRetentionModeDesc: Retain forever: keep every submission. Retain N days: a daily job deletes submissions older than the threshold. Delete after export: purge a conversation's submissions as soon as it is exported.
agentSettings.submissionRetentionDaysDesc: Submissions completed more than this many days ago are deleted by the daily cleanup job.
agentSettings.analyticsSeInstanceDesc: Search-engine instance where this agent's analytics intent index is written. Leave as None to use the global default (or the first registered instance).
agentSettings.maxPromptTokensDesc: Estimated upper bound on the per-turn prompt size (chars/4 heuristic). 0 disables the check. Pair with the over-budget behaviour below to decide what happens when the estimate exceeds the budget.
agentSettings.overBudgetBehaviorDesc: WARN: log and proceed. ERROR: short-circuit the LLM call with an error reply. COMPACT: reserved for future workspace-backed compression (V1 degrades to WARN).
agentSettings.monthlyBudgetUsdDesc: Soft month-to-date spend cap. Empty or 0 disables the gate. On breach the agent downgrades to the LLM below (if set) or logs a warning and proceeds — it never aborts a turn.
agentSettings.perTurnSoftCapUsdDesc: Logs a warning when a single turn costs more than this. Empty or 0 disables it. Post-hoc signal only — the cost is known after the LLM responds, so it never aborts the turn.
agentSettings.budgetDowngradeLlmDesc: Cheaper LLM to switch to for the rest of the month once the monthly budget is breached. Leave as "Warn only" to keep the current model and just log.
